reason: A URL-reading and web-content extraction plugin that fetches user-supplied pages, feeds, and APIs, then returns cleaned text or Markdown with batch reading and bounded same-host crawling.

summaries.zh: 读取网页、JSON API 和 RSS/Atom feed，提取干净正文并以紧凑文本或 Markdown 返回，支持批量读取与限定范围的网站链接遍历。
summaries.en: Reads webpages, JSON APIs, and RSS/Atom feeds, extracting clean content as compact text or Markdown with batch reading and bounded same-host crawling.

capabilities: Fetches content from user-supplied HTTP(S) URLs
Extracts and formats webpage main content
Reads JSON, RSS, and Atom feeds
Crawls same-host links within configured limits
